items.title: 5 beaten-down U.S. large caps with fair value upside above 25%
items.summary: Investing.com -- A screen of US large caps (over $10B market cap) filtered for a 1-year price drop of more than 10%, fair value upside above 25%, ROIC above 12%, and projected 3-year revenue CAGR above 5% returned 14 names. These five stood out because the sell-off looks more like sentiment than damaged earnings power. Screener values are snapshots and may lag live prices. Prices are the Nov 16, 2026 closes.
